narrative.overview:
Source authority is Bizzy's DESIGN.md and app/assets/css/theme.css. BISS UI
extends that established visual language for research and administration. Operate
mode uses warm surfaces, white panels, compact controls and restrained blue actions.

All 130 Vue and 130 Svelte components share this system, including the renamed
caselaw APIs and public-page compositions. There is no separate legacy visual
foundation; the old Caselaw stylesheet has been removed.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, quiet surfaces with clear borders.
Compact sans-serif typography and consistent control rhythm.
Host-controlled data, labels and composition in both frameworks.

rules.name: The Shared Source Rule
rules.body: `src/theme/tokens.json` owns runtime tokens and generates the CSS and TypeScript exports. The frontmatter records the design contract; change runtime values in that source, then regenerate the exports. Customize semantic CSS properties on a host wrapper rather than layering a second theme.

rules.name: The One System Rule
rules.body: Every component uses the shared foundation. Styles are organized into `src/styles/foundation.css`, `forms.css`, `layout.css`, `content.css`, `bizzy.css`, `library.css` and `editors.css`, composed by `index.css` with the generated tokens. Do not restore a legacy stylesheet or introduce another visual foundation for a component family.

dos: Do use the shared token source and the same visual system in both frameworks.
Do preserve visible focus, semantic controls and host-configurable labels.
Do let actions and metadata wrap at phone widths.
donts: Don't use color alone to communicate state.
Don't use glass, gradients, display-scale marketing type, uppercase labels or ornamental borders.
Don't layer overrides over the removed Caselaw stylesheet.
